title: Green Line: a capacity-under-development instrument
description:
A capacity-under-development instrument: the green line of the docxology line-set. It records what is deliberately still being learned — apprenticeships, skills not yet mastered — with marker/counter-signal staging, and reads declared growth records against a versioned registry. Observations phrased as certification or credential language are staged aside with a note, never scored. It measures what is still growing — never competence, mastery, or virtue.

Code and prose are Apache-2.0 licensed. See LICENSE in the repository.
notes: Part of the Line Set family of independent instruments, its colorless Main reader, and the Witness Register outside LINE_SET; see the current Line Set declaration. Copper documents dimensioned finite-resource allocation arithmetic and burden attribution; Iron documents scenario-bound recorded recovery comparisons, not Green's learner-owned marker coverage. The last verified version DOI, for an earlier edition, is 10.5281/zenodo.22833492; it does not identify 0.4.0. The existing automatic GitHub-to-Zenodo integration was explicitly authorized on November 8, 2026; resulting archives still require verification under docs/publication.md.
